description: This file defines template classes for WebSocket link management within the WPEFramework, including server and client WebSocket handling, connection state, data serialization/deserialization, and upgrade procedures.

classes.name: HWebSocketLinkType
classes.description: Template class managing WebSocket connection states and data handling, including nested HandlerType classes for inbound and outbound message processing.

classes.name: HWebSocketServerType
classes.description: Template class representing a WebSocket server that manages WebSocket links, handling server-specific behaviors and state.

methods.name: Link
methods.description: Returns a reference to the underlying link object.

methods.name: Link
methods.description: Returns a const reference to the underlying link object.

methods.name: RemoteId
methods.description: Returns the remote identifier string for the connection.

methods.name: LocalId
methods.description: Returns the local identifier string for the connection.

methods.name: IsOpen
methods.description: Checks if the WebSocket link is currently open.

methods.name: IsSuspended
methods.description: Checks if the WebSocket link is suspended.

methods.name: IsClosed
methods.description: Checks if the WebSocket link is closed.

methods.name: IsWebServer
methods.description: Checks if the link acts as a WebServer.

methods.name: IsUpgrading
methods.description: Checks if the link is currently upgrading.

methods.name: IsWebSocket
methods.description: Checks if the link is a WebSocket.

methods.name: IsCompleted
methods.description: Checks if the linking process is completed.

methods.name: Binary
methods.description: Sets or gets the binary mode of the connection.

methods.name: Masking
methods.description: Sets or gets masking behavior for the connection.

methods.name: Protocols
methods.description: Returns the WebSocket protocols.

methods.name: Protocols
methods.description: Sets the WebSocket protocols.

methods.name: Query
methods.description: Returns the query string.

methods.name: Origin
methods.description: Returns the origin string.

methods.name: Upgrade
methods.description: Initiates a WebSocket upgrade request.

methods.name: AbortUpgrade
methods.description: Aborts an ongoing upgrade process with a specific status and reason.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens the WebSocket connection, waits up to specified time.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the WebSocket connection, waits up to specified time.

methods.name: Ping
methods.description: Sends a ping frame.

methods.name: Trigger
methods.description: Triggers the underlying handling process.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Flushes pending messages.

methods.name: Submit
methods.description: Submits an outbound message for sending.

methods.name: LinkBody
methods.description: Handles the inbound request body.

methods.name: Received
methods.description: Handles received inbound message.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Sends outbound message.

methods.name: ReceiveData
methods.description: Receives data from the data frame.

methods.name: SendData
methods.description: Sends data over the data frame.

methods.name: StateChange
methods.description: Handles state transition events.

methods.name: IsIdle
methods.description: Checks if the link is idle.
